rules.question: Which chart reading makes the Preview another song?
rules.owner: PreviewController::open in src/ui/preview_controller.cpp, from an app::ChartReading (Settings::reading)
must_match: const PreviewSongKey key{entry.md5, difficulty, pro, bass2x, noteshuffle};
return PreviewSongKey{md5, r.difficulty, r.prodrums, r.bass2x, r.noteshuffle};
must_not_match: PreviewSongKey open_key_;  // the song open() last loaded
void start_notes_job(const store::ChartLibraryEntry& entry, const PreviewSongKey& key);
rules.note: The Preview's song key is built in one place, from the ChartReading open() is handed. The four choices once travelled as a positional bool list, which has no spelling a search can match; the shared ChartReading value is the real guard, and this row only flags a second place building the key. Tests build keys on purpose, so the scope is src. Decided by: concept audit M19.
